image.name: calibre
image.description: [Calibre](https://calibre-ebook.com/) is a powerful and easy to use e-book manager. Users say it's outstanding and a must-have. It'll allow you to do nearly everything and it takes things a step beyond normal e-book software. It's also completely free and open source and great for both casual users and computer experts.

changelog.desc: Rebase to resolute.
Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Add Wayland init logic.
Rebase to selkies. Breaking Change: HTTPS is now required. Either use a reverse proxy with SSL cert or direct connect to port 8181 with HTTPS.
Rebase to noble.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.
Fix fullscreen on start.
Install libxcb-cursor0 for v7 support.
Rebase to KasmVNC base image.
Set the window title to `Calibre`. Remove websocat as it is now handled properly in the baseimage.
Deprecate Arch branch.
Start calibre window maximized.
Rebase to jammy.
Add arm64 build for master branch.
Update dependencies for Calibre 6.
Rebase to focal.
Fix umask.
Add speech support to bionic image.
Add arch branch for arm platforms.
Fix the HOME folder.
Add libnss3 back in. Make sure Calibre can access environment variables.
Start calibre on container start rather than gui connect.
Rebase to rdesktop-web baseimage. Deprecate `GUAC_USER` and `GUAC_PASS` env vars. Existing users can set the new var `PASSWORD` for the user `abc`.
Switch to python3, add various new dependencies for calibre 5.0.
Remove reccomended deps and zenity for character compatibility.
Add python-xdg.
Add fonts-wqy-microhei ttf-wqy-zenhei fcitx-rime dependency to resolve issue with Chinese encoding.
Add libxkbcommon-x11-0 dependency to resolve issue with Calibre 4.
Add zenity for international character support in dialog boxes.
Download binary from calibre website instead of github.
Add new env var `CLI_ARGS` to pass start arguments to calibre.
Initial release.
Let Calibre access environment variables, add optional umask setting.

env_vars.name: PASSWORD
env_vars.desc: Optionally set a password for the gui.

env_vars.name: CLI_ARGS
env_vars.desc: Optionally pass cli start arguments to calibre.

volumes.desc: Where calibre should store its database and library.

ports.desc: Calibre desktop gui (only for reverse proxy access).
Calibre webserver gui (needs to be enabled in gui settings first).

security_opt.desc: For Docker Engine only, many modern gui apps need this to function as syscalls are unkown to Docker.

image.title: Calibre
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:8181/

In the wizard, make sure to select the default library location `/config/Calibre Library` as the path for books. We will not provide support if you use a different path.

Calibre's built-in webserver is not enabled by default. If you wish to use it, please enable it in Calibre Preferences under `Sharing over the net`. Make sure to leave the port setting as `8081` and check the box to start it automatically.

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  calibre:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/calibre:latest
    container_name: calibre
    security_opt:
      - seccomp:unconfined #optional
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - PASSWORD= #optional
      - CLI_ARGS= #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/calibre/config:/config
    ports:
      - 8080:8080
      - 8181:8181
      - 8081:8081
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=calibre \
  --security-opt seccomp=unconfined `#optional` \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e PASSWORD= `#optional` \
  -e CLI_ARGS= `#optional` \
  -p 8080:8080 \
  -p 8181:8181 \
  -p 8081:8081 \
  -v /path/to/calibre/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/calibre:latest
